causes.what: The rollout of application version 413 began at about 11:02 on app-01 and reached app-02 at about 11:05. It appears to have caused database errors in the app tier, probably an incompatible change such as a schema or migration change shared with the 412 hosts; the DB hosts themselves look healthy. The web and lb 5xx alerts are downstream symptoms.

evidence: app-01 app.db.errors.rate went 0 to 8.45 at 11:02:10, and its version changed to 413 at 11:02:32 (info alert 11:02:32). Its DB-error problem opened at 11:03:10.

app-02 version changed to 413 at 11:05:12. App-03 and app-04 were still on 412 at 11:04 and 11:06 but started DB errors anyway, at about 11:05 and 11:07 (about 7 per second), so the errors spread through the tier in sequence rather than following each host's own version.

db-01 and db-02 are healthy: db-01 connections stayed at 50-70 for the whole hour with no step change, slow queries 1-3 per second, io wait 6.75%, CPU 28%, replication lag 1.2s. nas-01 latency was 5.4 ms, hv-01 CPU ready 2%, and cache-01 hit rate 89% with no loss on any host, so no infrastructure fault was found.
Web 5xx and lb-01 5xx alerts opened at 11:03:17-11:03:57, right after the first app DB errors at 11:02:10 and app-01 alerting at 11:03:10. App response time is about 1000 ms and queue depth 46-58.
No alert predates 11:02, so there are no older unrelated alerts.
